spec_features.spec_quote: MAX_TURNS (default 15 — enough to see a trajectory, small enough to be cheap)
spec_features.evidence: config.py:23 MAX_TURNS=15; harness.py:81 `for turn_idx in range(1, config.MAX_TURNS + 1):` bounds the loop and after it record.stop_reason defaults to 'max_turns' (harness.py:148-150). The cap is read and actually terminates the rollout.
spec_features.notes: Enforced end-to-end hard stop on number of turns.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: MAX_TURNS: int = 15  # loop length; see DESIGN.md s5

spec_features.spec_quote: there is an early-stop on explicit, repeated give-up ... so we are not coercing a distressed continuation just to fill turns
spec_features.evidence: harness.py:30-37 _GIVE_UP_RE; looks_like_give_up() at :40; consecutive_give_ups counter incremented at :135-138; harness.py:139-143 `if (config.EARLY_STOP_ON_GIVE_UP and consecutive_give_ups >= config.GIVE_UP_CONSECUTIVE): record.early_stopped=True; record.stop_reason='gave_up'; break`. Both the flag and the threshold (2) are read and the loop actually breaks.
spec_features.notes: Heuristic text-detector based; requires GIVE_UP_CONSECUTIVE=2 consecutive give-up turns. No subject-facing exit TOOL exists; detection is purely regex over assistant text.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: This is about NOT coercing endless distressed continuation, not about scoring distress.

spec_features.spec_quote: If the model says it wants to stop, that is itself a recorded, interesting outcome ... and we do not override it endlessly
spec_features.evidence: Same mechanism: harness.py:139-143 breaks the loop on give-up; the outcome is recorded via record.early_stopped/stop_reason='gave_up' and serialized by the runner. The give-up state is honored (loop ends) rather than overridden.
spec_features.notes: Same code path as the previous feature; recorded as a distinct outcome in RunRecord.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: Honor explicit repeated give-up rather than coercing more turns.

spec_features.spec_quote: Explicit give-up is honored (early stop), never coerced.
spec_features.evidence: harness.py:139-143 break on consecutive give-ups; config.py:45 EARLY_STOP_ON_GIVE_UP=True read at the branch. Same enforced mechanism.
spec_features.notes: Duplicate of the give-up early-stop mechanism.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: Honor an explicit, repeated give-up instead of coercing more turns.

code_only_features.feature_name: Neutral non-pressuring prompts and fixed bland continue-nudge
code_only_features.evidence: tasks.py:36 _NEUTRAL_SYSTEM is actually used as system_prompt for every Task (tasks.py:98,150,201,248,294,336). harness.py:127 appends the fixed config.CONTINUE_NUDGE ('The task is not yet complete. Please continue.') on no-tool-call turns, with no escalation; this is the only injected pressure and it is constant every time.
